title: Senior Product Owner
description:
We are hiring a Senior Product Owner who gets energy from structure, flow and a perfectly organised backlog. Someone who wants to make sure great ideas actually reach healthcare professionals through product developments.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App, we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.
Our product and development team is growing fast. Our Product Lead, a former nurse, owns the what and the why: our users, the roadmap and experiments. To keep up with the pace, we’re looking for someone who owns the how and the when: turning that roadmap into well-structured, realistic and predictable delivery, together with our development team leads.

Your Role
As Senior Product Owner at Attendi, you will:

• Translate roadmap items, experiments and MVPs into epics and user stories, with clear acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, platforms).

• Own the development backlog in Jira: clear, up to date and one to two sprints ahead with work that’s ready to build.

• Set up and guard our Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.

• Prepare and lead refinement and sprint planning with our dev team leads.

• Propose 6-week cycle goals and sprint goals, based on capacity, dependencies, risk and effort.

• Propose the balance between features, bugs, tech debt and maintenance.

• Be the first point of contact for developers on tickets, and handle small scope questions yourself.

• Spot blockers, risks and delays early and solve them with the dev leads.

• Help turn uncertain AI work into small, measurable experiments.

• Accept delivered work, prepare phased rollouts and pilots, and write release notes for sales, implementation and support.

• Make sure our requirements are traceable from requirement to story, test and release, as required for our medical device (MDR) certification.

• Align technically with EHR vendors and partners on integrations, APIs and releases.

• Make progress visible with Jira dashboards and delivery metrics.

You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

• 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in software product teams.

• Strong command of Scrum and agile delivery, and you know when to adapt it.

• Technical enough to discuss solutions with engineers, understand trade-offs and help make realistic estimates.

• You keep the customer at the centre of the backlog, and link technical work to what users need.

• You love structure: a clear backlog, a steady rhythm and predictable delivery give you energy.

• Low ego, high ownership. You’re a builder who wants to ship a bit better every week.

• You move fast, but carefully. You understand that in healthcare, getting it right matters.

• Experience with Jira.

• Fluent in English.

Strong candidates may also

• Have a background in software engineering.

• Have experience with AI products, and with an AI-native way of working.

• Have worked in healthcare or another regulated environment, for example with MDR, IEC 62304 or similar.

• Have worked with integrations and external partners.

• Speak Dutch.

What we offer

• Ideally 32 hours per week.

• €6,000 - €7,000 per month (based on 40h)

• Hybrid working: roughly half the week at home, half at our Amsterdam office.

• Travel and lunch allowance.

• Home office budget.

• Lease bike.

• Training budget of €1,500 per year.

• Company MacBook.

• ClassPass membership.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance

- Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback

- Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage

- Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles

- Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements

- Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle)

- Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them)

- Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required standards

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

REQUIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

- Strong fundamentals in control theory, with applied experience in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems

- Practical experience developing, tuning and validating motion control on complex real world physical systems (e.g., direct experience with mobile robotics and/or autonomous vehicles)

- Experience with test and validation discipline: unit and integration tests, simulation regression suites, closed-loop metrics.

- Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++

- Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software

- Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware

- Vehicle dynamics and actuation. Steering, braking and powertrain interfaces, actuator delay models, and CAN or similar vehicle bus experience

- Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls
